ValidationRule.description: Must be in Lead Stage 3-Sales Accepted and validate First Name, Address & Industry before Converting this lead #34927: Remove requirement for 'Industry' when Lead is converted
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName ='IME_Lead', OR(ISPICKVAL(Status,'Converted'),IsConverted), OR(NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(IM_Lead_Stage__c) , "3-Sales Accepted")), ISBLANK( FirstName ), ISBLANK(Street), ISBLANK(City), ISBLANK(Country), ISBLANK(PostalCode) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Must be in Lead Stage 3-Sales Accepted and validate First Name & Address before Converting this lead
